Employee — Edit

The Employee form allows you to create and edit employee records in your business.

Employee records are essential for managing your workforce and processing payroll. Each employee record stores important personal and employment information that can be used across various features in the system.

You can include photos of employees by uploading an image file. This helps with identification and adds a personal touch to employee records.

The information entered here will be used in payslips, timesheets, expense claims, and other employee-related transactions throughout the system.

This form contains the following fields:

Name

Enter the employee's full name as it should appear on payslips and other employment documents.

This name will be displayed in dropdown lists throughout the system and on all employee-related transactions.

Code

Enter a unique employee code or ID number to identify this employee in the system.

Employee codes are optional but recommended for larger organizations. Common examples include employee numbers, payroll IDs, or department codes.

This code helps with quick selection in dropdown menus and can be used for integration with payroll systems.

Address

Enter the employee's complete residential or mailing address.

This address is used for official correspondence, tax documents, and payroll records.

Include street address, city, state/province, postal code, and country for complete employee records.

Email

Enter the employee's work or personal email address for business communications.

This email is used for sending payslips, expense claim notifications, and other employment-related documents.

Ensure the email address is current and actively monitored by the employee.

Currency

Select a foreign currency if this employee is paid in a currency different from your base currency.

This setting affects all employee transactions including Payslips, Expense Claims, and reimbursements.

Useful for expatriate employees or remote workers in different countries. This field only appears if foreign currencies are enabled.

Division

Assign this employee to a specific division for cost allocation and divisional reporting.

All payroll costs and expense claims for this employee will be allocated to the selected division.

This field only appears if divisions are enabled under Settings → Divisions.

Control account

Select a custom control account if this employee should use a different employee clearing account than the default.

Custom control accounts help segregate different employee types, such as permanent staff vs contractors, or by department.

This field only appears if custom control accounts for employees have been created under Settings → Control Accounts.

Inactive

Mark this employee as inactive to hide them from dropdown selection lists while preserving all historical records.

Use this for employees who have left the organization. Their payroll history and transactions remain in the system for reporting.

You can reactivate an employee at any time by unchecking this box.
